description: This C# source file defines the PayloadSizeColumnAttribute class, which is an attribute used to configure a custom column in benchmarking results to display payload sizes with a specific format and label. It relies on BenchmarkDotNet configurations and custom column creation, providing a way to annotate classes for benchmarking purposes.

classes.name: PayloadSizeColumnAttribute
classes.description: An attribute class that adds a custom column to benchmark results to show payload sizes, converting and formatting various numeric types into a string with byte units.

methods.name: PayloadSizeColumnAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the attribute with a custom configuration containing a method result column for payload size.
